response.original_title: FIRE PRO WRESTLING WORLD presents STARDOM The way to major league 2020
response.overview: The Way to Major League 2020 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on February 8, 2020 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. In the main event, World of Stardom champion Mayu Iwatani faced off against the "Ace of Marvelous" Takumi Iroha in a fierce non-title match, after her originally scheduled opponent Sareee was unable to compete.
